messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — latency spike yesterday for model-v2 serving. Need to lock down SLO changes, remediation owners, and dashboard updates. Proposed temporary changes: increase p95 target to 250ms for model-v2 on Dedicated (scope: us-west) for 2 weeks; bump throughput baseline SLO from 600 qps -> 650 qps to reflect traffic shift; add an error-budget burn alert at 20% over a 12h window. Thoughts?

michael: +1 to temporary, scoped change. Don’t touch global SLA. I can own dashboard changes and the SLO dashboard PR.

sam: I can own remediation investigation — will look at KV cache eviction patterns and batching behavior. ETA EOD Thu. Will open a Jira and add action items.

riley: Can we add a routing canary to fall back to model-v1 if p95 > 300ms? Quick safety net. I can prototype in staging today.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary route created in staging by @riley (canary-routing-2026-03-23).

anya: Owners then: remediation -> @sam, dashboard -> @michael, canary/rollout -> @riley. Sam please open Jira and link to the postmortem doc. Michael, post the dashboard link here when ready. Riley, implement canary in staging then coordinate a watch window with me before prod. I’ll write the temporary SLO governance note (expiry after 2 weeks).

sam: Jira opened: RED-4721 "model-v2 KV cache investigation". Tags: eng-sre, eng-platform. Added checklist and estimated subtasks. ETA 2026-04-01. I put the postmortem link in the Jira description.

michael: Dashboard draft (internal): https://dash.redwood.local/d/model-v2-slo — added p95, p99, error-budget burn panel, and a simple recurrence detector for Friday evening spikes. Sharing in #eng-oncall for eyes.

riley: FWIW, recurring observation — every Fri 20:00 UTC we see a small throughput spike from batch jobs that impacts batching behavior. Recommend either scheduled padding or moving batch jobs off-peak. Added note to RED-4721.

anya: :thumbsup: Good catch. I’ll add the temporary scoping note to the SLO governance doc (expiry timestamp: 2026-04-06). If error-budget burn >20% in 12h, we auto-rollback to model-v1 and page eng-oncall.

michael: I added a Prom alert: slo_burn_model_v2_12h > 0.2 -> page eng-oncall. Also added a Graf panel for rolling 12h burn to the dashboard.

sam: Ran initial heap and cache profiles. KV eviction rate spikes correspond to the latency window; batching shrank to 1 for hot prefixes. Hypothesis: prefix hashing unevenness + transient burst. Plan: enforce min_batch_size=4, tighten batch_timeout_ms, and make prefix hashing deterministic. Testing now.

riley: Can you paste the config snippet for the min-batch change?

sam: ```
# inference service config snippet
min_batch_size: 4
batch_timeout_ms: 12
prefix_hash_seed: 12345
```

anya: Nice. Once Sam confirms test results, we schedule a targeted deploy with a 30m watch and rollback plan. Michael, mark the dashboard with the watch window. Sam, link the test logs and perf numbers in RED-4721. Riley, after staging canary, coordinate the prod switch with me.

sam: Will attach test logs and a perf diff. Early tests show p95 improvement ~15% under synthetic burst.

riley: Staging canary is green. P95 stayed under 220ms for the canary slice. I'll prepare the rollout playbook in the PR.

anya: Thanks team. I’ll update the postmortem follow-up doc with owners, timelines, and the temporary SLO entry. We’ll review at next SLO retro. Closing thread after dashboard link + Jira status update.
